rules.interaction: Secondary summary (brochure rev. 2015) of the Law Against Discrimination; the statute itself is not in this document.

all.unavailable: owner occupies the other unit of a two-family dwelling, or rents a room in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling

rules.title: NJ Law Against Discrimination: source of lawful income (vouchers)
rules.requirement: A landlord cannot refuse to rent to someone because of the source of lawful income or rent payment, such as a Section 8 voucher.
rules.key_value: Ban on source-of-income discrimination (incl. Section 8 vouchers)
rules.coverage_conditions: Sale or rental of all property, residential or business
rules.exemptions: Single apartment in a two-family dwelling where the owner lives in the other unit; room rental in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling; religious organization preference; housing for older persons (familial status only)
